bull.point: Operating cash flow conversion is extremely robust, consistently backing reported earnings.
bull.evidence: 173% of reported profit turned into operating cash over 6 years and CFO/PAT reached 200.63% in Mar 2026.

bull.point: Quarterly revenue growth is accelerating strongly driven by top-line expansion.
bull.evidence: YoY revenue growth expanded to 30.0% in Sep 2026 with revenue reaching ₹ 3,30,601 Cr.

bull.point: Capex intensity is coming down while telecom visibility remains high.
bull.evidence: Management noted bulk of capex is behind after 5G completion and expects high teen growth for Jio.

bear.point: Free cash flow has historically been volatile and negative in multiple periods.
bear.evidence: Free cash flow was negative in 2 of last 6 years (₹ -76,560 Cr in Mar 2021 and ₹ -16,770 Cr in Mar 2023).

bear.point: Working capital efficiency has degraded over recent years.
bear.evidence: Cash conversion cycle lengthened 28 days in 2 years (-3 to 25).

bear.point: Retail margin pressures persist from scaling online operations and macro risks.
bear.evidence: Analysts highlighted lower EBITDA margins in retail due to online business scaling and inflation/currency headwinds.
